answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the karst partition is computed from the walnut history, the juniper audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 15 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 2 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
